description: LLMs demonstrate 'behavioral self-awareness,' the ability to articulate their own learned behaviors without in-context examples.

instances.assertion: LLMs demonstrate 'behavioral self-awareness,' the ability to articulate their own learned behaviors without in-context examples.
LLMs finetuned on specific behaviors can explicitly describe those behaviors without explicit training or in-context examples.
LLMs can spontaneously articulate their own learned behaviors without explicit training or in-context examples.
